title: Steamed Dumplings with Jamaican Sprouts
description: A delicious Chinese-inspired dish combining steamed dumplings with crunchy Jamaican sprouts.
instructions: Combine dough ingredients and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press edges together.
Place dumplings on a steamer basket.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add sprouts and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add crunchy to the pan and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve the cooked dumplings with the sprouts mixture.
